users.title: User Management

fields.name: Name
fields.passwordHint: 8–120 chars, must contain letters and digits.
fields.tenantHint: UUID of the tenant the user belongs to.

users.selectTenantFirst: Select a tenant to see its users.

permissions.label: Extra permissions
permissions.CONFIG_ADMIN_hint: Service settings (/admin/config) and Google Drive connection
permissions.TENANT_MASTER_hint: Tenant settings (/admin/tenant), menu visibility by role, sees all allowed menus
permissions.AUDIT_VIEWER_hint: View-only access to Audit (/admin/audit) logs and access control — changes need the tenant master

tenants.title: Tenant Management
tenants.description: Manage registered tenants and per-tenant menu visibility.

fields.name: Name
fields.entIdHint: Tenant UUID. Must match existing users’ ent_id.
fields.codeHint: Short code used in the portal login URL/form. Lowercase letters/digits/hyphen, unique per academy.

menus.title: Menu visibility
menus.hint: Only enabled menus appear in this tenant’s admin sidebar (does not affect data permissions).

masters.title: Tenant masters
masters.description: Tenant masters manage tenant settings (menu visibility by role, default timezone).

google.title: Google OAuth app settings
google.description: The Google app (OAuth client and Picker API key) shared by all tenants. Register it once; each tenant then signs in with its own company Google Workspace account at /admin/config/drive.

project.title: Create a project
project.body: Sign in to Google Cloud Console with the Amoeba (service operator) account and create or select a project dedicated to ACM.

apis.title: Enable APIs
apis.body: In APIs & Services → Library, enable "Google Drive API" and "Google Picker API".

consent.title: OAuth consent screen
consent.body:
User type: Internal is recommended. If the accounts that connect belong to the same company Workspace as the Google Cloud project, it works right away with no security assessment. Choose External only if Workspace accounts of other companies must connect too.
Branding: enter app name "ACM", support email and optional logo, then the app home page, privacy policy and terms of service links and the authorized domain below.
Data access (Scopes): add the 3 scopes below. The full Google Drive scope (…/auth/drive) is needed to show files already in shared folders; Google classifies it as a restricted scope.
With External, click "Publish app" to move to production (testing status requires reconnecting every 7 days). Until a security assessment is done, connecting shows an 'unverified app' warning and is limited to 100 users.
ACM itself rejects personal Gmail accounts (Workspace only).

client.title: Create OAuth client ID
client.body:
Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID → application type "Web application".
Enter the origin and redirect URI below exactly, create it, then paste the Client ID and Client Secret into the form below.

apiKey.title: Create API key for Picker
apiKey.body: Create credentials → API key. Set application restriction to "Websites (HTTP referrers)" and add the value below. Restrict the API to "Google Picker API" only.

projectNumber.title: Find the project number
projectNumber.body: Dashboard → copy the numeric "Project number" from the Project info card (not the text project ID).

form.title: Registration
form.secretHint: The secret shown when creating the client (GOCSPX-…). Stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.secretKept: Saved. Enter only to change it (blank keeps it).
form.redirectHint: Must exactly match the redirect URI entered in step 4.
form.clientChangeWarning: Changing the Client ID may break existing tenant Drive connections. Each tenant may need to reconnect at /admin/config/drive.
form.saveError: Could not save. Check the input format.
form.clearConfirm: Delete the saved Google OAuth settings and use the server environment values? If none are set, Drive connections stop working.

test.OK: Google accepted the Client ID, secret and redirect URI.
test.INVALID_CLIENT: The Client ID or secret is invalid.
test.REDIRECT_MISMATCH: The redirect URI does not match the one registered in the Google client.
test.GOOGLE_UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach Google. Try again later.
test.UNKNOWN: Could not verify. Check the values again.
